newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Gradual S$ liberalisation helpful - Goh quoted.
newsitem.headline: Gradual S$ liberalisation helpful - Goh quoted.

text.p: Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong said gradual Singapore dollar internationalisation would encourage local companies to do business outside Singapore, the Business Times said on Friday.
It quoted Goh as telling Singapore reporters accompanying him on a trip to Europe that it would otherwise be difficult to get Singapore companies to go regional.
But Goh said the government remained basically hesitant about turning the Singapore dollar into a reserve currency, the newspaper said.
It quoted Goh as saying Singapore would have to slowly allow more lending in Singapore dollars if there was demand.
"Otherwise, it would be difficult to get Singapore companies to do business outside if you don't lend them Singapore dollars to do business outside Singapore."

Goh had been asked about comments by Finance Minister Richard Hu earlier in the week. Hu had said the Monetary Authority of Singapore's policy was to permit gradual internationalisation of the Singapore dollar.
